entities.summary: Zdislava Rosalina Augusta Braunerová, called Zdenka was a Czech landscape painter, illustrator and graphic artist, whose work was influenced by her connection to Paris. She was the first female member of the Mánes Union of Fine Arts, and a patron of numerous other Czech artists.
